name: Hollis
positioning: Fictional over-ear headphones, used to study the structure of a hardware product page: a scroll-scrubbed hero, big numbers, a pinned feature list and autoplay clips.
audience: People comparing premium wireless headphones on specs, battery and comfort.
voice: Specs in plain numbers: hours, grams, decibels

direction.tier: Show-piece. Reference structure: hardware product pages (Apple AirPods Max, Sony, Bose), measured for layout only. No reference media, copy or fonts; every visual renders in code (three.js model, 2D canvas clips).
devices: Exploded view: the cups come apart on scroll so each part can be named
Clay orange appears only on the driver ring, the clip accents and the primary action
invariants: One headphone model, one finish, rendered in code
Black stage for the product, light grey for reading
Geist for everything; numbers set large
variables: Which part is named in the exploded view

motion.character: Hero: the model turns from front to side and the cups separate into shell, driver and cushion as you scroll. Numbers count up once. Features: pinned list, the active line lights up and its clip plays. Clips: muted loops that play in view, each with its own pause button.
motion.reducedMotion: The model renders once, exploded. Numbers show final values. Clips show one still frame and stay paused. Nothing pins.
